bias.en: Uptrend · MACD crossed up, back above $541
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · MACD 上穿，重回 $541 上方

read.en: Microsoft rose 2.7% on Nov 9 to $545.18, trading $538.70–548.28. It is above all five of its rising averages: the 5-day ($537.70), 10-day ($531.00), 30-day ($528.91), 100-day ($473.97) and 200-day ($440.24). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 9 and is above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($508.15), and RSI is 57.5.

The close reclaimed $538.3–542.3 (Nov 6 high, Oct 29 high, Nov 4 low), now support, though the $548.28 high stopped short of the $551.15 Oct 13 high. Resistance is $548.3–551.2, then $557.6–559.2 (Nov 5 high, 52-week high) and $575. Support is $537.7–542.3, then $528.9–531.0 (30 and 10-day) and $505–508 (Nov 2 low, SAR). A close above $551.2 would target $559; below $537.7, $529–531.

s.en: Oct 29 high $541.29; Nov 4 low $542.30, reclaimed; 5-day average $537.7
